profile.reading:
This location is tagged to AT&T at 901 East Palmdale Boulevard in Palmdale, Los Angeles County, California, in the high desert Antelope Valley area of northern Los Angeles County. The building does not appear in any wholesale or colocation focused data center directory, a pattern consistent with an incumbent telephone central office rather than a modern multi tenant colocation facility. AT&T, through its predecessor Pacific Bell and later corporate successors, has operated a dense network of such central offices across California for more than a century, most of them built to house telephone switching equipment and, in recent decades, increasingly repurposed to also carry network and edge computing gear rather than being marketed as commercial data centers open to outside tenants.

Palmdale itself has a modest telecommunications and light industrial presence relative to the more built up coastal core of Los Angeles County, consistent with a central office serving a regional customer base rather than a large scale, tenant facing computing campus. No square footage, power capacity, or year built figure has been documented for this specific building in available public records, and no claim is made here about AT&T's current operational role at the address beyond the facility name itself. This entry is recorded as an honest gap rather than filled in with estimated or invented figures.
